scope: Retain Approved Bill document type with term-specific description on new records; automatically refresh completion status without a manual Refresh link.
sourceDocument: Spring 2027 Approve Your Bill Issues & Questions_-6.pdf
dependencies: Existing verified CF-033 environment baseline; no other newly prepared unit required.
notes: Nonprod actual behavior supports named document ID plus custom description despite the Swagger restriction. The actual changed service verified both reporting fields, stable retry identity and cleanup.
New documents only: existing custom-description records are not backfilled. Existing recovery by approval reference is preserved.
Status endpoint binds to current student and term, returns only three booleans and no-store, and performs no billing refresh, tax, approval, job retry or email operation.
Polling is bounded to two minutes or three failures; changed approval and true failure/pending states remain visible. No registration-complete claim is made without verified clearance.
promotionNotes: Deployed on isolated environment-specific release branches. For later promotion/removal, select this unit and verify the current target release; preserve unrelated units, settings and assets.
removalNotes: Revert only this unit from the current target release. Preserve later/unrelated units and any stored historical records. Data side effects are not reversed by code removal.
